title: C5

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Schuberth C5 is delivers one-handed chin bar actuation paired with certified dual-homologation protection, pairing a quick-flip chin bar with certified impact protection. Featuring a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) architecture at 1601g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~89 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with a glove-friendly Micro-Lock Ratchet retention system.

product_details.description: The masterpiece of flip-up helmets with P/J homologation.

variants.title: Schuberth C5 Gloss Black
variants.description: The Schuberth C5 is a benchmark Modular helmet crafted in Germany 🇩🇪. Built around Direct Fiber Processing (DFP) glass fiber reinforced with carbon matrix tuned in Magdeburg acoustic wind tunnels, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Engineered for highway touring flexibility, featuring a dual P/J homologated flip-up chinbar, one-handed latch mechanism, and integrated sun visor. German aero-acoustic precision delivering unmatched cabin quietness.

product_details.description: The masterpiece of flip-up helmets with P/J homologation.

variants.introduction: Positioned in Schuberth's Modular lineup, the C5 brings German engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
variants.story:
The Schuberth C5 represents Schuberth's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~89 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Schuberth C5 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: Schuberth C5 Gloss Black (gloss finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: Schuberth C5 in Schuberth C5 Gloss Black. A dependable modular workhorse engineered for straightforward daily commuting and weekend touring flexibility.
variants.fitment_notes: Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes with temple pressure-relief grooves for eyewear. 3D contoured cheek pads experience a 12-15 riding hour break-in period, relaxing by ~15% for facial fitment.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval to intermediate head shapes; requires precise sizing due to modular hinge mechanism.

technical_analysis: Features Direct Fiber Processing (DFP) glass fiber reinforced with carbon matrix tuned in Magdeburg acoustic wind tunnels paired with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna. The interior utilizes Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Schuberth C5: combining Germany 🇩🇪 craftsmanship with City-position visor ratchet system with integrated drop-down sun visor and pre-installed Sena SC2 Mesh antenna and Seamless individual customizable lining with Anti-Roll-Off System (AROS) for neck retention stability. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Schuberth C5: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Schuberth C5. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Schuberth C5 is a benchmark Aero-Acoustic Premium Touring helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.
